contract: A23-46: subs H1 (Halo, Bright), R1 (Horns, Smokey), N3 (everyone, Tiny) open after M2_3, once each: talk to the NPC -> H1 stay 10 s at WoodsGate (outside PvP) -> 2 king slimes / R1 stay 15 s at the fountain (Crossroads zone) -> 6 slimes / N3 both bridge ends -> 30 hunting gold -> the pick at the NPC (A = one Enh70, B = 3 HP potions + 60 gold, 1 honor / infamy point, Neutral A / B recorded only) -> +120 gold + half a level bar of XP, a closing question. E4 Near.Stay counts seconds in one go (leaving resets, the row shows %d/%d s). E6 pick rewards go through LootService.GrantItem (items / potions, caps, 1..99). Npc steps need the player within StoryQuests.NpcRange of the CollectionService-tagged NPC (attribute NpcId) when it exists, never pop up by themselves, and rows carry Story.Npc. A23-57: Config.Features.NeutralFaction = false -> Config.Pickable refuses Neutral at the picker / altar (logged) and rebirth; the guild-only subs N1 / N2 are not offered; Neutral saves keep N3. quest_volume §2-6: StoryQuests.MaxSubs = 3 sub rows (claim / waiting card > situational > started or S0 > the rest, newer first in a rank, no Rank / Order sent), so a town quest in progress stays on the list.
limitations: NPC models, '!' markers, the talk window and the quest marker routes are game dev 1's (contract: tag StoryNpc, attribute NpcId, row Story.Npc / Guide). Real walking, physics and the 1 s loop timing are modelled by moving the root and calling Refresh each second.
